purpose: Handle the 16 soul-special equipment and the single unresolved-no-path equipment explicitly after general/exclusive consumer generation, preserving known data without admitting them to public equipment consumers or inventing acquisition semantics.

special.policy: Preserve the full known semantic/display blocks for future reference, but do not place these records in the general or exclusive equipment consumer. Empty GetPathList is not reinterpreted as unrestricted/global/shop acquisition.

hold.policy: ID 2013 remains an explicit hold. Preserve its known metadata and semantic blocks, but do not infer an acquisition path, public tab, unrestricted availability, global availability, shop availability, or chronology.

recordPolicy.identity: Use equipmentId/nameCn plus Stage 3-2 display metadata. Only VERIFIED_REFERENCE_MATCH Korean names may be copied; review candidates remain null.
recordPolicy.classification: Copy Stage 2-3 filter fields and Stage 2-7 equipmentType/label/sortIndex/acquisition class exactly.
recordPolicy.stats: Copy Stage 2-4 stats exactly without recalculation; current maxLevel remains 50.
recordPolicy.effect: Copy Stage 2-5 maxEffectSkillId/effectName/effectText/effectSegments exactly without translation, summary, or rewrite.
recordPolicy.restriction: Copy Stage 2-6 mode/generalArmyIds/specialJobIds exactly. Existing structural-inference semantics are not upgraded.
recordPolicy.acquisition: Copy Stage 2-7 releaseGroupDate/confidencePercent/classificationBasis and raw GetPathList count as evidence only.
recordPolicy.routing: Both buckets are intentionally excluded from normal general/exclusive page routing in Stage 3. Their equipmentId remains a stable identity key for diagnostics and future explicit consumers.

hardRequirements: all 16 soul-special records have siteTab null, empty GetPathList, the 魂· name prefix, and the frozen soul-special classificationBasis
the hold bucket contains equipmentId 2013 only, with siteTab null, empty GetPathList, and the frozen unresolved classificationBasis
special and hold IDs do not overlap Stage 3-3 general IDs or Stage 3-5 exclusive IDs
the four Stage 3 buckets are pairwise disjoint and their union is the full 390 canonical equipment IDs
icons must remain direct Stage 3-2 values and review Korean-name candidates must not leak
all preserved stats/effects/restrictions/classification/acquisition fields exactly match frozen upstream outputs
no acquisition path, public siteTab, release chronology, or unrestricted/global/shop meaning is invented
reviewAllowed: unverified Korean display names inherited from Stage 3-2
soul-special acquisition meaning beyond its observed empty-path plus 魂· prefix classification
Stage 2-6 runtime equip-check direct proof remains unlocated

completion: All 17 non-general/non-exclusive canonical records are explicitly preserved in either HIDDEN_SPECIAL or HOLD_UNRESOLVED_ACQUISITION, and the 390-record Stage 3 partition closes without semantic invention.
